description: Executable architecture boundaries. AGENTS.md states the direction in prose; this registry is the machine-readable form the gate enforces. A rule here is a claim about the real import graph, not an aspiration: `npm run architecture` fails when source or a declared dependency crosses a forbidden edge.
rules: A zone is a set of repository path prefixes. A module specifier is classified as a workspace package, an external package or a relative path resolved back to its zone.
Relative imports are resolved before matching, so a deep relative path cannot dodge a package-name rule.
Declared dependencies in package.json, template.json, recipe.json and adapter.json count as edges, because a dependency is a coupling whether or not a file imports it yet.
This gate answers one question: is the dependency direction legal. Prose mentions of a package are a different question and stay with the doctors.

tooling-cli holds CLIs, doctors and tests. It reads every zone on purpose — a verification script importing what it verifies is not a coupling — so it is not constrained as a `from` zone. tooling-lib is the deterministic factory implementation the service delegates to and imports nothing from apps/.

The parser is deliberately conservative: example import syntax inside a test fixture or documentation string counts as an edge. It therefore fails closed, never open. A fixture that must contain a forbidden specifier belongs in tooling-cli, which is unconstrained, rather than inside a constrained zone.

boundaries.reason: Generated projects are ordinary repositories. They must build and run with no App Builder package, Console, service, MCP adapter or agent runtime present.

The Console is a human interface. It calls the service over its contract instead of owning generation, ingestion, composition or durable orchestration. Two couplings are deliberate and permitted: @app-builder/contracts for shared data contracts, and @app-builder/factory-core for deterministic intake helpers such as manifest construction and questionnaire typing. Both are dependency-free pure libraries. Generation, ingestion and orchestration remain the service's, and reaching them directly is what this rule forbids.
MCP is an adapter over the service tool contract, reached by HTTP. Importing service internals would make it a second implementation of the factory rather than a client of it.
Durable task, event, ChangeSet, checkpoint, policy, role and routing primitives must not acquire a dependency on an app, a model provider or a runtime.
Shared contracts are consumed by every other zone. Anything they import becomes a transitive dependency of everything.
Composition is a deterministic function of manifest and knowledge. Reaching into an app or the control plane would make generation depend on runtime state.
Source normalization produces trusted knowledge for the factory. It must not depend on the interface that happens to display it.

cycles.reason: The verified zone graph is cycle-free. A new cycle means two zones have stopped being separable and fails immediately.
